# Max_Site — Career/Project Portfolio Website

Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS personal portfolio website, inspired by a Figma moodboard ("Hello My Name is Max" hero concept with image showcase grid).

## Structure
- [src/app/page.tsx](../src/app/page.tsx) composes the page from section components.
- [src/components/](../src/components) — Nav, Hero, About, Projects, Experience, Contact, Footer.
- [src/data/site.ts](../src/data/site.ts) — editable content (profile, projects, experience, nav links).
